name: session-status
description: Status band above the prompt (working, needs you, in the background, waiting, error, stopped) with the session title, editable

color_working.title: Color: working
color_working.description: Background while Claude works (hex or color name)

color_attention.title: Color: needs you
color_attention.description: Background while it asks for permission or asks you a question

color_background.title: Color: in the background
color_background.description: Background when the turn finished but subagents, workflows or shells keep working and will wake the session

color_idle.title: Color: waiting for you
color_idle.description: Background when the turn finished and it waits for your message

color_error.title: Color: error
color_error.description: Background when the turn ended in an error

color_stopped.title: Color: stopped
color_stopped.description: Background when you interrupted it, or before the first message
